PayloadFacts.description:
The candidate-derived facts a prompt may contain: nothing the model could use to anchor.

Deliberately small and closed. It carries the rule identifier, the CWE numbers, the sink family
and the slice strategy (all vocabulary owned by CodeKavach) and the clauses of the stub
summaries (a fixed grammar with no identifiers beyond public names). It has no severity, path,
author, commit or pull-request field: the engine's opinion would anchor the model
(``docs/research/INSIGHTS.md`` section 2.2 item 4), and a path is a disclosure.

PrivacyLevel.description:
Privacy level, ordered by strictness, not by the digit: L1 < L2 < L3 < L4 < L0.

Rank (ADR E03-01 decision D5): L1=1, L2=2, L3=3, L4=4, L0=5. L0 sends nothing, L4 sends
abstract facts but no code, L3 a pseudonymised slice, L2 pseudonymised files and L1 code with
only secrets and PII replaced. Comparisons mean "stricter than", ``strictest`` returns the
maximum by rank, and ``at_least`` checks a floor. Ordering by the digit would make L0 the
weakest level and silently turn a floor of L3 into permission for L1.
